# (Note: token string previously printed; to avoid mismatch, reuse the variable if available)

# Re-load album to get song_ids
album = apis.spotify.show_album(album_id=1)
songs = album.get('songs', [])
print('album:', album.get('title'), 'song count:', len(songs))

song_stats = []
for s in songs:
    sid = s.get('id')
    info = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    song_stats.append({
        'song_id': sid,
        'title': info.get('title'),
        'artists': [a.get('name') for a in info.get('artists', [])],
        'play_count': info.get('play_count'),
        'album_id': info.get('album_id')
    })

# Sort by play_count ascending (least listened)
song_stats_sorted = sorted(song_stats, key=lambda x: x.get('play_count', float('inf')))
print('play_count by song (ascending):')
for row in song_stats_sorted:
    print(row['song_id'], row['title'], row['artists'], 'play_count', row['play_count'])

least = song_stats_sorted[0]
print('LEAST:', least)
least_song_id = least['song_id']
